These are useful. I can already separate them into two different clue families: one is the World Monochord / interval-placement family, and the other is the Templum Musicae / solmization-number family. I’m going to treat the latter as a candidate pointer system rather than as evidence that the correction itself is encoded there.

Interpreting the scans

I’m examining the supplied engravings for titles, captions, numerical ratios, and cosmic diagrams. I’m matching those visual clues against first-edition copies while keeping later reproductions separate from primary evidence.
